claims: The Artemis II mission splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission splashed down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II mission had a four-person crew.
The four-person crew completed a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The first crewed Artemis lunar landing is currently planned for 2028.
The Artemis II mission was a successful conclusion of a 10-day lunar orbit mission.
Artemis IV (2028) aims to land humans on the lunar surface.
